g.text: Laplace — what each feedback lane may change
23.1 Observe a pass, its consequences or later evidence
23.2-23.3 Classify the signal and its provenance
no testimony, calculus or firmware change
external observer rates the responsible firmware
Do not re-rate claims merely because the act succeeded
fold claim standing into an adjudicated epoch
evidence for reusable program, not claim truth
Use CPU / latency / I/O / boundary measurements
to evaluate an equivalent accelerated path
Keep semantics, authority and admissibility checks
An empty query result alone is not a vacancy.
23.8 Hypothesis with predicted signature and ancestry
Survives evaluation and has explicit activation authority?
Reality supplies occurrence, testimony or experiment
predicted occupant cannot fill its own vacancy
retain rejection as negative knowledge when rejected
Rejoin subsequent passes through shared canonical state
or the current pass's bounded working projection
Firmware does not grade itself. Its standing does not multiply claim standing.
Replay and retries create no new matchups. Self-generated descendants
cannot corroborate their ancestor hypothesis. C1 and C3 remain explicit conflicts.
